text:
katie: quick heads-up — pre-QBR run into a blocker with Meridian onboarding demo. live sandbox quota flakiness, need fallbacks + slides updated. who can triage?
ben: saw error logs, looks like token auth timeout from staging gateway. cc @infra-oncall
samir: can we swap live demo -> recorded clip + a short interactive walkthrough if sandbox unstable? that'll keep execs happy.
tosin: I can rework slide 4 (demo flow & fallback) and create a 90s recorded demo. need access to clip assets from eng.
katie: assigned: @tosin slide 4 + recorded demo, @ben investigate infra error, @samir craft fallback script. target: EOD Wed.
ben: started debugging. here's the failing curl: 
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://staging.api.redwood.ai/demo/start
# returns 504 intermittently
```
ben: possible hotspot on gateway LB, raising support ticket with infra.
samir: I'll draft a 60s script for exec narration. also adding a one-slide "what if live fails" flow.
katie: need a short runbook with stepwise actions for production fallback (can be used during exec Q&A). sample checklist below:
```
- If demo start fails -> show recorded clip (90s)
- If clip missing -> show screenshot + narrated bullets
- If exec asks about performance -> point to latency dashboard (Console > QBR > Meridian)
- Post-QBR: create incident ticket + follow-up actions
```
tosin: where do we store the clip? share link and I'll embed in slides.
ben: uploading to GDrive now -> link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1MeridianDemo
calendar-bot: Reminder: QBR rehearsal scheduled Thu 2026-04-02 16:00 UTC. Please RSVP.
katie: thanks. All good — I'll own the runbook doc and send final slide deck by Wed 10:00 PT. call out any blockers before EOD Tue.
samir: noted. will post draft narration in thread by EOD Tue.
ben: infra ticket #INC-1798 opened, pinged @infra-oncall. will update status here.
tosin: clip link received, starting edits.
katie: :thumbsup: moving to exec alignment prep — @jordan from sales and @leila from customer will review deck tomorrow. tagging them on final draft.
jordan: happy to review, pls tag changes in slide notes.
leila: I'll prep customer health snapshot slide + renewal risk summary.
katie: perfect — close loop after rehearsal. thanks team.
